title: A general improbability result for non-collision singularities as subsystems with at most four particles
summary: Non-collision singularities of the $n$-body problem are initial conditions for which no global solution exists and which, however, do not lead to a collision in the limit; i.e., the moment of inertia of the system diverges. The question of whether the set of initial conditions leading to non-collision singularities in the $n$-body problem is improbable is open and is the first on Barry Simon's list of fifteen problems in mathematical physics from the year 1984.
